description.value: The Pizza King is a takeout-and-delivery-only pizza and pasta spot on East Broadway, offering made-to-order pizzas in three sizes, baked pastas, and salads. The operation is streamlined for quick pickup and online ordering with no dine-in option. Cyclists passing through the East Broadway corridor can grab a hot meal but will need to find seating elsewhere.

address.value: 1464 E Broadway, Vancouver, BC V5N 1V6, Canada
